bullets.title: TED Radio Hour - Comfort Zone
bullets.note: This was a really fun podcast to be a part of. Guy Raz ([@guyraz](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/opfkhq/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9ndXlyYXo=)) is exceptionally good at his craft, and I learned a lot from the other guests included.

bullets.section: Location I am considering traveling to —
bullets.title: Yala National Park
bullets.note: Here is something about it that caught my eye: “Yala harbours 215 bird species including six endemic species of Sri Lanka. The number of mammals that has been recorded from the park is 44, and it has one of the highest leopard densities in the world.”

bullets.title: Instagram
bullets.note:
, [Twitter](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/xksph6/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9WYXN5bExvbWFjaGVua28=))**, who — as a friend put it — “does things no one else can do.” I have no idea why it took so long for me to find this mind-blowing southpaw. These videos help explain why many consider him the best pound-for-pound fighter in the world (including ESPN): [Highlights and history](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/60aeh8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj01VmVpZVNSQ2puWQ==), [techniques](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/kmbmh6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g_dj1DQVU0blBDMmRHdw==).

**Person I’m learning more about —  
[Alfred Lee Loomis](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/52hvh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvQWxmcmVkX0xlZV9Mb29taXM=)** — (November 4, 1887 – August 11, 1975) was an American attorney, investment banker, philanthropist, scientist/physicist, inventor of the LORAN Long Range Navigation System, and a lifelong patron of scientific research. The book that made me fascinated by Alfred’s life is titled [Tuxedo Park : A Wall Street Tycoon and the Secret Palace of Science That Changed the Course of World War II](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/r8u063gzzaohv240p/2ou2ho/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9UdXhlZG8tUGFyay1TdHJlZXQtU2NpZW5jZS1DaGFuZ2VkL2RwLzA2ODQ4NzI4ODk=).
